summary: Genius Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resolution to convert 10 million Class A ordinary shares held by CEO Roger Hamilton into Class C ordinary shares with ten votes per share, reducing publicly tradable shares. No price, premium, or deal value is stated. The filing is a routine share reclassification, not a special situation. No transaction, recommendation, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This event lacks the hallmarks of an acquisition, tender, or other special category.
